test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The difference in invests earned on Rs. 1,50,000 at an 8% rate of interest Per annum in a year when the interest in compounded semi-annually and annually, respectively, is Rs. ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Principle (P) = Rs. 150000

Rate (r) = 8%

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

CI = P(1 + (r)/(100))^t - P

CI = SI (for 1 year) = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

When interest is compounded annually, 

CI = (150000 × 8 × 1)/100
